ceo_directive: Model generates test protocol BEFORE seeing experimental results (prevents post-hoc justification)
status: PRE-REGISTERED — acceptance criteria defined before any experimental data exists
purpose: Validate engineering simulation against physical data

test_article.device: eShunt prototype with ePTFE membrane sleeve (ARCH-001)
test_article.membrane: ePTFE, 50um thick, 0.05um pore, 30 kDa MWCO (W.L. Gore)

acceptance_criteria.measurement_method: Sensirion SLI-0430 liquid flow meter, continuous 60s average
Spectrophotometer at 280nm, inlet vs outlet albumin concentration

acceptance_criteria.baseline: 0% (IgG at 150 kDa should be retained by 30 kDa MWCO membrane)

acceptance_criteria.acceptance_threshold: Flow tracks model within ±15% across 0-90% fouling
acceptance_criteria.measurement_method: Weekly flow measurement during 12-week accelerated fouling (ASTM F1980)

acceptance_criteria.acceptance_threshold: ≤10 mmHg at 0% fouling (≤3 mmHg above baseline)

acceptance_criteria.measurement_method: Progressive occlusion test, measure dP when bypass opens

acceptance_criteria.baseline: N/A (bypass should close when dP drops)
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_threshold: ≤5s to close after dP drops below threshold
acceptance_criteria.measurement_method: Pressure cycling — raise dP to activate bypass, then drop dP, measure close time

pre_registration_statement: These 8 acceptance criteria are defined BEFORE any experimental data exists. This prevents the simulation from becoming post-hoc justification. If experimental results fail these criteria, the engineering model must be revised, not the criteria. Pre-registration hash: 6c7809be1724df8120fd082c4REDACTED-SCOPUS-PATTERN-MATCH
